faq1_q: When is the right time to start planning for study abroad?
faq1_a: We recommend starting as early as Class 9. This gives ample time to build a robust profile and plan extracurriculars without rushing.
faq2_a: While no consultant can guarantee admission to ivy-league universities, our track record speaks for itself. We maximise your chances by aligning your profile with university expectations.
faq3_q: Do you assist with selecting the right major or course?
faq3_a: Yes. We use detailed psychometric evaluations and industry insights to help you choose a course that aligns with both your passions and future market demand.
faq4_q: How do I start the process?
faq4_a: You can start by booking a free initial consultation through our contact page. We will assess your profile and discuss a personalized roadmap.
